title: A reserve with a controlled gate
use: Availability, access rules, withheld resources and a release condition.
description: A porcelain channel and two reservoirs are separated by an amber sluice. The gate lifts in guided rails, opening a clear connection, then holds.
copy: Use a native title above the mechanism. The action occupies the middle; source and limitations belong below. A closed-state hold precedes one opening, followed by a settled hold.
